testcase.name: cancelling a run releases the lease()
claiming a step records its owner and a lease, and finishing the step releases both()
a lease that ran out is reclaimed even though the run was touched recently()
a run without a lease keeps the old rule - untouched for the stale time means abandoned()
only the owner renews, and a renewal moves the lease forward()
a lease is judged by its own expiry, not by how long ago the run last changed()
two workers racing for one step - exactly one owns it()
an owner that keeps renewing is not reclaimed, one that stops is()
a lease longer than the stale time is honoured, and one that already ran out is reclaimed at once()
